title: V5 lab: manual RPC step-mode for cluster seal (stop auto loop)
brief: Owner-driven CY debug: stop deadline seal loop; advance cluster seal strictly via HTTP RPC steps with per-step max verbosity and wall timing in logs. Enables operator to restart cluster, align nodes, then walk one block through preflight→lease→propose→gate→seal without seal-ahead/poll races. Lab-only; default production path unchanged.

design.problem: Iter-2 debug required owner cluster restarts; automatic seal loop (deadline_poll + seal_ahead + 10ms gate poll) hides causality and overlaps propose timeout with sync lag. Need reproducible single-step execution with loud logs.
design.approach: Integral switch SealControlMode: Auto (today) | ManualRpc. In ManualRpc: do not run autonomous seal attempts (equivalent to pausing spawn_seal_loop body for proposer); expose decomposed steps callable via /v1/lab/seal/* on proposer RPC (localhost lab).

activation.guard: Only when cluster-enabled proposer OR explicit --lab-seal-api; reject on attester/follower with 409

auto_loop_behavior.manual_rpc: spawn_seal_loop still runs but proposer branch only: init check, optional block_timing flush, sleep(poll_pause) — NO preflight slot open, NO seal_ahead, NO record_cluster_prop_tick, NO run_cluster_gate, NO chain.seal

state.holder: App: SealManualState { mode, target_h, last_step, last_result, verbose_until_ms, step_t0_ms }
state.target_h: always tip_h+1 at step entry unless request specifies height (optional, default next)

rpc_surface.GET /v1/lab/seal/status: mode, tip_h, target_h, sync_ready snapshot (sync_n, live_n, peer_tip_max, max_lag), lease snapshot, round-state summary (open round, got/need, propose_opened_at_ms), last_step, last_step_ms, verbose_active
rpc_surface.POST /v1/lab/seal/step: { step, verbose?: true, timeout_ms?: optional for gate_wait }
steps_enum: preflight — count_sync_ready_attesters + cluster_seal_preflight; log per-peer sync_live (tip_h, cup_active, lag); no mutations
propose — single wire ClusterPropose for target_h (reuse peer_session propose path; NO seal_ahead / NO record_cluster_prop_tick unless this step runs); log wire send ack / seq
gate_poll — run_cluster_gate once (+ optional recheck flag); log gate_obs Wait|Timeout|Ready, attest counts, elapsed since propose
gate_wait — bounded loop gate_poll until ready or timeout_ms (for operator convenience)
seal_commit — mempool take + chain.seal + roaming expire; log sealed height; optional autosnapshot
step_all — run ordered chain preflight→lease→propose→gate_wait→seal_commit (abort on first fail; still one RPC for smoke)
rpc_surface.response_shape: { ok, step, target_h, tip_h_after, duration_ms, detail, warnings[], gate?: { got, need, elapsed_ms }, sync?: { sync_n, live_n, peer_tip_max } }

verbosity.per_step: POST .../step verbose=true sets RUST_LOG-equivalent scoped bump for this await only: pwmd::lifecycle=trace, pwmd::peer=trace, pwmd::sync=debug (implementation: ManualSealVerboseGuard or tracing span with target filters — no global permanent trace)
verbosity.fields: Each sub-phase logs t0/t1 (preflight_start, preflight_ok, propose_wire_sent, attest_rx, gate_ready, seal_done)
verbosity.block_timing: If PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_ENABLED, note_* on manual steps same heights as auto path

operator_workflow.1: Start attester, then proposer with --seal-control manual-rpc (or RPC switch after up)
operator_workflow.2: Align chain (owner restart/sync) until GET status shows sync_ready acceptable
operator_workflow.3: POST step preflight (verbose) — inspect logs both nodes
operator_workflow.4: POST step propose (verbose) — attester should attest; inspect peer logs
operator_workflow.5: POST step gate_poll or gate_wait — confirm quorum
operator_workflow.7: Repeat or POST control mode=auto to resume soak

non_goals: Public mainnet API without lab guard
TUI panel for step mode v1
Remote RPC without localhost bind check

acceptance_criteria: Proposer --seal-control manual-rpc: no sealed height advance without successful seal_commit step; no seal_ahead/propose side effects between steps
Each step with verbose=true emits manual_seal_* lines with duration_ms and key cluster fields (sync, gate, lease)
CY 2-node: operator script can seal one block via 4–5 RPC calls while tailing proposer+attester logs
POST control mode=auto restores autonomous loop without restart
Attester POST to lab/seal returns 409 with clear message
Unit tests: manual mode skips auto seal; step preflight returns sync snapshot; step_all aborts when preflight WaitingAttester
cargo test -p pwmd api + lifecycle manual_seal
Document RPC contract in runbook (request/response examples)

Verify seal_manual + shutdown Rust unit tests and Python console tests
